ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
(function() {
    let data;
    try {
        data = typeof src === 'string' ? JSON.parse(src) : src;
    } catch(e) {
        return [];
    }

    if (!data || !data.chapters || !Array.isArray(data.chapters)) {
        return [];
    }

    const source = data.source;
    const bookId = data.book_id;
  
    return data.chapters.map(chapter => ({
        name: chapter.title,
        url: `content.php?source=${source}&book_id=${bookId}&chapter_id=${chapter.chapter_id}`,
        info: `${chapter.volume_name}｜${chapter.update_time}`
    }));
})();
</js>
